spec_match.rationale: Targets the exact wire contract — the connectionallowlist iframe attribute causing Sec-Required-Connection-Allowlist on the frame navigation — using a real server route that reports the genuinely received header, plus honest detection of the (unreflected) IDL surface.

interactive.rationale: Two buttons re-navigate the live frame with and without the attribute (cache-busted), and the verdict reflects each navigation's postMessage report; the frame content itself shows the received header.

blurb_alignment.rationale: Index blurb promises a live echo with/without the attribute plus feature detection; that is exactly the page.

edge_cases.rationale: Distinguishes attribute-present-but-inert (pre-trial builds), no-attribute-no-header (correct everywhere), and header-received; the unexpected header-without-attribute case has its own worth-reporting branch.

references.rationale: Links chromestatus.com/feature/5657801797009408 and the embedded-enforcement explainer; the feature index adds the spec draft and CSPEE.

conformance.rationale: New 5-assertion suite records each header contract as kind: manual with the exact page to verify on an enforcing build — header-only contracts cannot be asserted from synchronous page script, and the suite says so instead of inventing fake probes.

runtime_evidence.rationale: Headless Chromium 141 (also with --enable-experimental-web-platform-features) via the repo CDP harness (no chrome-devtools-mcp in this cloud session): initial load, with-attribute and without-attribute navigations all driven; the live route reported the header absent in all three (attribute inert on this build) with the matching honest verdicts; IDL readout false; zero console errors, zero failed requests, 0px overflow; desktop screenshot read. Partial: the header-sent path needs an origin-trial build.

telemetry_health.rationale: caee-echo-roundtrip asserts the first frame report round-trip; message handling is origin-checked and type-gated so no noisy paths.

design_system.rationale: Design-system variables throughout; the framed document uses its own minimal palette (ivory-equivalent background, charcoal text) at AA.

accessibility.rationale: Buttons are native with 44px targets, the iframe carries a descriptive title, the verdict is aria-live=polite, and the definition list collapses on narrow widths.

mobile_desktop_parity.rationale: responsive-check matrix run for the feature id: mobile 360×740 DPR3 and desktop 1280×800, no horizontal overflow, console/network clean, both screenshots read.

openQuestions.title: Capture the header-sent path on an origin-trial build
openQuestions.detail: On a build with ConnectionAllowlistEmbeddedEnforcement enabled, verify the with-attribute navigation shows the echo frame reporting the exact requirement value and the verdict switching to the enforcing-path message.

guidanceConsulted.query: iframe embed security headers enforcement demo
guidanceConsulted.recommendation: Treat security policies as testable contracts; surface real header values rather than claimed ones; never fake an enforcement result.
guidanceConsulted.appliedOrException: The echo route reports the header the request actually carried, and the page's three verdicts are driven entirely by that report.

guidanceConsulted.query: iframe embed loading states accessible title
guidanceConsulted.recommendation: Give iframes descriptive titles and announce async outcomes in a polite live region.
guidanceConsulted.appliedOrException: The frame has a descriptive title and the single verdict output is aria-live=polite, written once per navigation.

summary: Wire-contract echo: a live server route reports whether Sec-Required-Connection-Allowlist arrived, driven with and without the attribute. Verified on headless Chromium 141 incl. experimental flags (repo CDP harness; no chrome-devtools-mcp in this cloud environment): honest inert-attribute baseline, clean console/network, 0px overflow both classes.
